job_location: Warsaw, Mazowieckie, Poland (remote from Poland; also listed for Kraków and Gdańsk)
responsibilities: Own and continuously improve data models, architecture, and analytics solutions that support our products as they evolve;
Design, build, and maintain reliable ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring data quality, performance, and scalability;
Help define the metrics and data requirements needed to measure product performance, feature adoption, customer behavior, and business impact;
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations for internal stakeholders and external customers;
Develop and improve monitoring, alerting, and data quality processes to ensure product health and reliability;
Make architectural decisions independently, balancing technical quality, business priorities, and speed of delivery;
Use AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar technologies to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, accelerate analysis, and increase productivity;
Continuously look for opportunities to improve processes, product performance, and the way our teams use data
